metadata.description: Fan-made interactive map and guide hub for Grand Theft Auto VI, covering the fictional state of Leonida (Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park). The site publishes 3,599 evidence-labelled guides and tracks only what Rockstar Games has confirmed or shown in official trailers.
